verdict_reason: The new message reads well, but it sits in the card-id map errors.cards, making that map's comment untrue, and the file's other comments break the house rules.

todos.issue: speciesNoLongerOffered (line 152) is added to errors.cards, a map whose keys are review card ids holding each card's 'Complete <card>' line (incomplete-cards.js:77 reads copy.errors.cards[card.id]; check-answers.test.js:1814 asserts each card id maps to a string). It is a function, not a card id, and it makes the comment on lines 144-146 ('One line per review card that still has answers outstanding') untrue.
todos.fix: Must: errors.cards holds only card-id keys, and the unlisted-species message lives under its own key in errors, mirrored in copy.cy.js, with no comment left untrue. One way: move it to errors.species.notListed (or similar) in both copy files, update refusal.js and the two tests, and delete the 144-146 comment.

todos.issue: Comments describe the page and its rendering rather than the lines below, and hold design rationale: 3-4 and 6-8 explain how blanks are drawn and what a screen reader is told; 49; 121-122; 137-138 ('The review ends with the button and nothing else...').
todos.fix: Must: no comment in the copy file holds rationale or describes the UI; each key's name says what the string is for. One way: delete the comments, renaming any key whose purpose they decode, and move the design rationale to docs/ or the behaviour spec.
